instruction: Candid documentary full shot of an outdoor paved path. On the left, the dark-haired woman in a black long-sleeved top and pants (R1) walks forward, lifting her right foot mid-stride while looking down. Her left hand rests on the shoulder of the white-haired woman in a black short-sleeved dress (R2) on the right, who steps forward with her right foot while looking down. They walk side-by-side in natural daylight.
elements: R1 rests her left hand on R2's shoulder
R2 is the person whose shoulder is being touched by R1
R1 and R2 walk side-by-side with R1 maintaining the shoulder contact
Both R1 and R2 are walking forward and looking down
The scene is an outdoor paved path in natural daylight
